conditions: Jets only, minimum 4 edges, 201 airports, no overhead subtraction, same observation means, random 3D starts, two-chain annealing (128 trials), at most 100000 steps; each reported run settled. Baseline is the previous deployed solver and fits.
conclusion: Modest improvement in long-flight fit and radial variation for seeds 71/72, worse short-flight fit and original all-edge error. Seed 73 remains in a poor local minimum. The trial does not establish a reliable improvement or certify spherical recovery.
